description: Observation attempting to persist a sensitive value (OTP digits). A compromised or buggy extension sends an ExecutionObservation step that includes the actual OTP value in a him_checkpoint field. Server must reject this observation.
rejection_reason: Observation contains prohibited sensitive value in him_checkpoint.entered_value field. Per ADR-0012 and perception-privacy.yml, secret-classified values MUST NOT appear in observations. The entered_value field does not exist in the observation schema — its presence indicates a redaction failure. Server rejects the entire observation and emits a security diagnostic.
